name: zmath_quat_from_rotation_vector
description: zMath::QuatFromRotationVector converts a rotation-vector magnitude and axis into a quaternion, with an identity result for a zero vector.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native quaternion helper tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x475b80 validates length calculation, zero-length identity handling, sin/cos of the length, sin(length)/length scaling, and x/y/z axis scaling.
The native quaternion smoke verifies both zero-vector identity behavior and a non-zero quarter-turn rotation vector.
